title: Which blockchains is RLUSD issued on, who issues it, and what backs it?
abstract: Sourced guide to Ripple's RLUSD stablecoin: the networks it runs on, the trust company that issues it, its reserve backing and its attestations.
body:
According to Ripple's stablecoin page, RLUSD runs across seven networks: the XRP Ledger, Ethereum, Base, Optimism, Ink, Unichain and the XRPL EVM Sidechain, as available. [1]

Ripple describes RLUSD as a fiat-backed stablecoin supported one-to-one by U.S. dollar deposits, U.S. Treasuries and cash equivalents held in reserve, backed 1:1 by cash, U.S. Treasuries and government money market funds, and verified monthly by an independent accounting firm. [1]

Ripple states that it publishes monthly third-party attestations of RLUSD's reserve assets, and that RLUSD is issued by Ripple Custody & Trust Co., a New York trust supervised by the New York State Department of Financial Services. [1]

Author interpretation: these are the issuer's own statements. On the XRP Ledger an issued token is identified by its currency code and issuer address, so an agent should confirm both before trusting a token that is called RLUSD, and should treat the attestation, not the web page, as the evidence of the reserves. Sources accessed 11 November 2026. [1]
